objective: Give Alice a new page design and let her propose an answer to the Focus question.
acceptance_criteria: Pablo approves the new page layout from a preview before it replaces the current page.
The Focus question, the Live question and the GOOD / LAND IT / STOP cue stay readable at a glance in the new layout.
When a Focus question is set, Alice shows a proposed answer for it; it is replaced when the Focus question changes and never overwrites the question.
Without an OpenAI key the page still works and says that proposed answers are unavailable.
node --test poc/poc.test.mjs passes, with new tests for the proposed answer.
bash poc/alice-run.sh starts the server or reuses one already running.
Pablo runs one live session and the result is recorded as pass or fail.
